name: 1991-95 Final Years
_rhythm_comment: The last four mapping entries are the rhythmic ones; everything before them is a
smooth envelope. The constraint is that beat response goes through GEOMETRY, never
through global luminance: plan 12 rate-limits mean-luminance delta per frame, so a
bright pulse on the beat gets clamped and the limiter dims the whole image in
response to it. Warp, zoom, rotate and palette are not rate-limited, and under a long
feedback decay a geometric pulse smears into the trails rather than fighting the
safety system. beatPhase and barPhase are RAMPS, pulse-shaped host-side before
routing (see RhythmicShape), and both scale with bpmConfidence so an untrusted grid
